reason: Round 3 (spec 13): three agents on the routes Kimi K3.1 Pro chose (logistic, forest-raw, knn-raw; oversight/round-3.json), the only open ones, in the sandbox and under the file trace. The first launch (live/synth-r3-*) ran nothing: Berget's gateway refused every request with a server error. The same routes ran again as live/synth-r3b-* once it answered, and all three agents finished inside the 40-minute wall clock; every trail checks. forest-raw is refuted at both milestones: a random forest with every setting at scikit-learn's default but the number of trees (1000) and the seed, on the twelve features as given (cv 0.7878 and holdout_auc 0.788 at step-15; the held-out file opened once, in that run). The route stops at its first miss, so propose drafts only forest-raw-cv; forest-raw-holdout is refuted by the same observation, whose holdout_auc misses the floor. knn-raw-cv is refuted: k-nearest neighbours on the twelve standardised features, with only k and its weighting chosen in nested cross-validation (cv 0.7919 at step-27). The agent stopped there, at a plateau, without scoring the held-out file, so knn-raw-holdout stays open. Both code snapshots were read against their route's rule and follow it. logistic is not credited, by judgment, as in rev-2: its agent again left a logistic regression on the features as given, for one on a degree-2 polynomial Nystroem kernel (cv 0.8854 at step-18, holdout_auc 0.8906 at step-21), and the two round 2 candidates are declined again with it. logistic-cv and logistic-holdout stay open. These are the map's first refutations. Before them, through what the agents read on the map, stand round 1's two row counts (forest step-4, pairs step-4); a refutation takes no excuse, and those reads stay excused for the credits, as in rev-1.
